confidence_notes: Holistic July estimate. Restaurant anchors reflect typical urban East Coast costs; lodging is less certain because hostel options are limited and summer or event dates can affect rates. Cocktail and wine estimates use their usual local premium over draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to a major Mid-Atlantic U.S. city, between lower-cost Baltimore or Pittsburgh and higher-cost New York or Boston; summer demand adds lodging variability.
